description: Cancel the confirmed booking held on a request, removing it from the business calendar. It cannot be undone; only do it when the customer asked. Use this for a booking made under a request; for one made without a request, use send_to_business with the cancel_booking skill. Needs a live grant with scope read_cancel or book. Calling it again returns the same result. Returns cancelled, booking_id and when. Refused with outcome_uncertain when the calendar cannot confirm the booking (read get_request), and grant_required without access. Requires direct:tasks.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by open_request or shared by the assistant that opened it.

name: cancel_request
title: Cancel a request booking
